target.title: fix(plugins): remove local dependency denylist
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw plugin installs still carried a built-in, hard-coded local dependency
denylist after ClawHub and operator policy became the intended trust boundaries.
That meant generic local, archive, and npm plugin install paths could be blocked
by OpenClaw's retired local dependency scanner instead of by ClawHub scanning,
`security.installPolicy`, or plugin `before_install` hooks.

## Why This Change Was Made

This removes the built-in local dependency denylist scanner from plugin install
and update validation while preserving the install policy and hook surfaces that
operators and plugins own. ClawHub trust and artifact integrity behavior stay on
the existing ClawHub paths; this PR only removes the hard-coded
dependency-denylist traversal and its package-name checks from OpenClaw install
code.

## User Impact

Plugin installs are no longer rejected solely because a package manifest,
vendored folder, or managed npm dependency tree contains a name from OpenClaw's
former built-in dependency denylist. Operators can still block installs with
`security.installPolicy`, and loaded plugins can still report findings, block
installs, or fail closed through `before_install` hooks.

## Evidence

Reviewer-checkable behavior:

- The net diff deletes `src/plugins/dependency-denylist.ts` and removes its
  traversal/call-site plumbing from plugin install scans.
- Tests now assert that formerly denied `plain-crypto-js` package names are
  allowed in manifests, vendored directories, and managed npm dependency trees
  when no operator policy or hook blocks them.
- Existing hook and policy tests remain in the focused proof to show
  `security.installPolicy` and `before_install` block/fail-closed behavior still
  runs.

Automated checks:

- `pnpm docs:list` passed.
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --write --threads=1 docs/tools/plugin.md src/hooks/install.ts src/plugins/install-security-scan.runtime.ts src/plugins/install-security-scan.ts src/plugins/install.ts src/plugins/install-security-scan.runtime.test.ts src/plugins/install.npm-spec.test.ts src/plugins/install.test.ts` passed.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passed.
- Stale scanner symbol check passed: `rg -n "dependency-denylist|built-in plugin dependency denylist|OPENCLAW_INSTALL_SCAN|additionalPackageDirs|allowManagedNpmRootPackagePeerSymlinks|PackageExecutableScanMetadata|scanPluginDependencyDenylist" src docs package.json pnpm-lock.yaml` returned no matches.
- AWS Crabbox `cbx_1157c9335667` / `run_f6ae09c2162c` passed on the final rebased head: `corepack pnpm test src/plugins/install-security-scan.runtime.test.ts src/plugins/install.test.ts src/plugins/install.npm-spec.test.ts && corepack pnpm test src/hooks/install.test.ts && env OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 OPENCLAW_CHANGED_LANES_RAW_SYNC=1 corepack pnpm check:changed`.
